verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a local CLI/TUI coding agent, and nothing in the evidence shows a configurable cloud environment with dependency installs or setup scripts. AGENTS.md build and test commands are agent instructions, while the Landlock/Seatbelt sandbox and worktrees are local isolation features, not reproducible cloud environments, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
